name: bmo-growth-inflation-factor-scatter
description: BMO reproduction: Growth vs Inflation factor scatter for G10+EM currencies. Inflation score = z-scored CPI YoY, Growth score = z-scored Industrial Production YoY, both from FRED. 13 Tier 1 currencies with clean monthly data.
source:
# =============================================================================
# BMO REPRODUCTION: GROWTH VS INFLATION FACTOR SCATTER
# =============================================================================
# Approximation of BMO's macro factor framework (page 2, 2026-03-09 report).
# For each currency:
#   - Inflation Score: z-scored YoY CPI change (3yr rolling window)
#   - Growth Score: z-scored YoY Industrial Production change (3yr rolling window)
# Uses FRED data via economic_indicators() for 13 Tier 1 currencies.
#
# Currencies: USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, NOK, SEK, BRL, KRW, HUF, PLN, ZAR, COP, CLP
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()

# =============================================================================
# DATA FETCH + SCORE COMPUTATION
# Pattern: fetch FRED index -> ffill -> 252d YoY return -> 756d z-score
# 252 trading days ~ 1 year, 756 trading days ~ 3 years
# =============================================================================

# --- USD ---
us_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='CPIAUCSL')()
us_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(us_cpi_r_src.result)))
us_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='INDPRO')()
us_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(us_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- EUR (Euro Area) ---
eur_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='CP0000EZ19M086NEST')()
eur_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(eur_cpi_r_src.result)))
eur_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='EA19PRINTO01IXOBSAM')()
eur_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(eur_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- GBP (United Kingdom) ---
gbp_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='GBRCPIALLMINMEI')()
gbp_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(gbp_cpi_r_src.result)))
gbp_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='GBRPROINDMISMEI')()
gbp_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(gbp_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- CAD (Canada) ---
cad_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='CANCPIALLMINMEI')()
cad_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(cad_cpi_r_src.result)))
cad_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='CANPROINDMISMEI')()
cad_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(cad_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- NOK (Norway) ---
nok_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='NORCPIALLMINMEI')()
nok_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(nok_cpi_r_src.result)))
nok_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='NORPROINDMISMEI')()
nok_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(nok_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- SEK (Sweden) ---
sek_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='SWECPIALLMINMEI')()
sek_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(sek_cpi_r_src.result)))
sek_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='SWEPROINDMISMEI')()
sek_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(sek_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- BRL (Brazil) ---
brl_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='BRACPIALLMINMEI')()
brl_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(brl_cpi_r_src.result)))
brl_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='BRAPROINDMISMEI')()
brl_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(brl_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- KRW (South Korea) ---
krw_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='KORCPIALLMINMEI')()
krw_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(krw_cpi_r_src.result)))
krw_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='KORPROINDMISMEI')()
krw_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(krw_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- HUF (Hungary) ---
huf_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='HUNCPIALLMINMEI')()
huf_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(huf_cpi_r_src.result)))
huf_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='HUNPROINDMISMEI')()
huf_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(huf_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- PLN (Poland) ---
pln_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='POLCPIALLMINMEI')()
pln_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(pln_cpi_r_src.result)))
pln_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='POLPROINDMISMEI')()
pln_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(pln_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- ZAR (South Africa) ---
zar_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='ZAFCPIALLMINMEI')()
zar_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(zar_cpi_r_src.result)))
zar_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='ZAFPROMANMISMEI')()
zar_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(zar_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- COP (Colombia) ---
cop_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='COLCPALTT01IXOBM')()
cop_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(cop_cpi_r_src.result)))
cop_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='COLPRINTO01IXOBSAM')()
cop_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(cop_ip_r_src.result)))

# --- CLP (Chile) ---
clp_cpi_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='CHLCPIALLMINMEI')()
clp_infl = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(clp_cpi_r_src.result)))
clp_ip_r_src = economic_indicators(series_id='CHLPROINDMISMEI')()
clp_grow = zscore(window=756)(returns(period=252)(ffill(clp_ip_r_src.result)))

# =============================================================================
# SCATTER CHART: Growth Factor (x) vs Inflation Factor (y)
# Point[i] maps to inputs at positions (2i, 2i+1) for (x, y)
# =============================================================================

labeled_scatter(
    title='Who Has the Best Growth and Inflation Mix?',
    category='FX Macro Factor Map',
    x_axis_label='Growth Factor Score (z-scored IP YoY)',
    y_axis_label='Inflation Factor Score (z-scored CPI YoY)',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=1,
    points=LabeledPointSchema(points=[
        LabeledPointSpec(label='USD', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='EUR', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='GBP', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='CAD', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='NOK', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='SEK', color=Color.Blue),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='BRL', color=Color.Cyan),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='KRW', color=Color.Cyan),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='HUF', color=Color.Cyan),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='PLN', color=Color.Cyan),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='ZAR', color=Color.Cyan),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='COP', color=Color.Cyan),
        LabeledPointSpec(label='CLP', color=Color.Cyan)
    ]),
    x_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    y_reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0, title='', color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    order=0
)(us_grow, us_infl, eur_grow, eur_infl, gbp_grow, gbp_infl, cad_grow, cad_infl, nok_grow, nok_infl, sek_grow, sek_infl, brl_grow, brl_infl, krw_grow, krw_infl, huf_grow, huf_infl, pln_grow, pln_infl, zar_grow, zar_infl, cop_grow, cop_infl, clp_grow, clp_infl)
